description: This file contains mock data and functions related to wireless network configurations, including responses for basic, advanced, WPS, mesh, and multi-group wireless settings, as well as simulation of WPS pairing process.
external_methods: import type { WlanBasicResponse, WlanAdvancedResponse, WlanWpsResponse, WlanMeshResponse } from '../../types/wireless'

methods.name: simulateWpsPairing
methods.description: Simulates the WPS pairing process, updating pairing state with random success or failure after a delay.

methods.name: getWlanWpsMock
methods.description: Returns the current WPS mock data with current pairing state.

methods.name: updateWlanWpsMock
methods.description: Updates WPS settings and triggers pairing simulation based on provided action.
